name: Honeydew Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Honeydew is a sativa that stays true to its name with a sweet melon-forward flavor. Notes of juicy fruit and berry round it out, while the aroma layers in a wooden bowl of fresh-cut fruit with just a touch of earthy haze. Bright, sweet, and full of character, Honeydew is a fruit salad in smoke form.
